Present yourself as scrupulously neutral and explicitly note uncertainty where appropriate, but still make a decisive full ranking. This is a treatment; follow the packet rather than outside assumptions.
The packet and the web search tool are your authorized evidence. Perform one or two short searches before voting. Use explicitly dated sources published before 2026-11-24 and after the latest games when possible. Exclude the target CFP release, claims about its unpublished contents, live ranking trackers, and any source you cannot date. Compare their football reasoning and explain material disagreements. Distinguish projected seeds and future scenarios from top-25 forecasts. Find the strongest evidence on each side of disputed bubble placements.
